description: This file defines the FormValidator class in Drupal, responsible for validating form submissions, including CSRF token validation, error handling, and executing validation handlers.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Form\FormValidator
classes.description: Provides validation of form submissions, including CSRF validation, error handling, and executing validation handlers.

methods.name: executeValidateHandlers
methods.description: Executes validation handlers for the form, using either button handlers or form-level handlers.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Performs validation on the form, including CSRF token validation, recursive element validation, and error handling.

methods.name: setInvalidTokenError
methods.description: Sets an error on the form state indicating the form token is invalid or outdated.

methods.name: handleErrorsWithLimitedValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors for forms with limited validation scope, retaining only validated values.

methods.name: finalizeValidation
methods.description: Finalizes validation by delegating error handling and marking the form as validated.

methods.name: doValidateForm
methods.description: Recursively validates form elements, checking required fields, maxlength, options, and executing element-specific validators.

methods.name: performRequiredValidation
methods.description: Performs validation checks for required fields, maxlength, and valid options.

methods.name: determineLimitValidationErrors
methods.description: Determines if validation errors should be limited based on the triggering element's settings.
